svg.title: Two layers. Different answers.
svg.desc: Qwen3.5-0.8B released edit: 130,188 changed BF16 entries in the MLP down projections of layers 15 and 19, with 64 of 3,584 columns changed in each. All 488 tensors were audited. Paired grids each show the same 500 MATH-500 problems in dataset order, with shade encoding 0–4 correct samples. Sample accuracy rises from 157/2,000 (7.85%) to 1,025/2,000 (51.25%); share at the 32,768-token cap falls from 92.90% to 30.55%. Recorded H200 reference run, not a new benchmark or edit discovery. Separate replay restored exact bytes.
